name: Progress toast
summary: A bottom-right card that tracks one long-running task (import, export, upload) from start to finish — icon, name, bar, caption and its terminal states.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-progress-toast> — a pure view of a single background task. It shows a leading file/task icon, the task name, a determinate bar (the DS <aha-progressbar>, announced once as a progressbar) and a caption row with an optional action such as Cancel. It updates in place through five states — progress, success, cancelled, offline, error — by toggling attributes on persistent nodes, so the bar fill animates instead of being recreated. The ✕ appears on terminal states only. A `footer` slot carries what the task needs next: an inline cancel confirmation, retry buttons, or an <aha-csat> rating. The consumer owns the task, the copy and any auto-dismiss (a successful card is typically dismissed ~2s after state="success", unless a rating is shown).
codeNote: Reach for <aha-progress-toast> for ONE long-running task that outlives the screen action that started it. It is not a one-line confirmation (Toast), a titled message (Notification) or a blocking wait (Modal / Spin). The first consumer is the presenter's slide Import notification.

spec.label: Card
spec.value: white · 320 wide (max 100vw − 32) · radius 12 · padding 14/16/16 · Elevate/Overlays shadow

spec.label: Top row
spec.value: 24px icon · heading 13px bold, ellipsis · check-circle 16 on success · ✕ tertiary icon button on terminal states

spec.label: Bar
spec.value: DS <aha-progressbar> small (6px), primary fill; hidden on success/cancelled/error, muted on offline

spec.label: Caption row
spec.value: 12px secondary caption left · slot=action right (e.g. Cancel)

spec.label: Error
spec.value: heading in negative text + red-20 1px hairline over the shadow

spec.label: Placement
spec.value: inline by default · `floating` pins it bottom-right (24px inset, z-index 1100)

props.name: state
props.desc: Which of the five states the card shows

props.name: heading
props.desc: Task name (file name), or a status headline such as "Import cancelled" / "Connection lost" / "Import failed"

props.name: description
props.desc: One supporting line under the heading

props.name: caption
props.desc: Bottom-left text beside the bar, e.g. "42%" or "12/40 slides"

props.name: floating
props.desc: Pin the card bottom-right of the viewport

props.name: dismiss-label
props.desc: Accessible name of the ✕ — pass the translated string

props.name: slot=icon
props.desc: 24px leading icon, e.g. a branded file-type icon

props.name: slot=action
props.desc: Bottom-right control while running, e.g. a Cancel link-button

props.name: slot=footer
props.desc: Block under the body: cancel confirmation, retry buttons, or <aha-csat>

props.name: dismiss
props.desc: Composed CustomEvent when the ✕ is pressed — the consumer removes the card

whenToUse.when: one long-running background task the user can keep working beside — slide import, export, bulk upload
a one-line past-tense confirmation with nothing to track
a titled message with detail and at most one action, not a live task
the user must wait for or answer the task before continuing

opinion.note: One card per task, updated in place — never stack a new card per state. The card has no timers: auto-dismiss success (about 2s) in the consumer, and leave cancelled / offline / error on screen until the user acts. Offline offers Keep waiting + Cancel in the footer; error offers Try again. After success, ask for a rating by slotting an <aha-csat> into the footer instead of auto-dismissing. Write copy in the British spelling the DS uses: "Import cancelled".
opinion.dsv3: New composite of shipped DS parts: Progressbar (bar), Button (✕, actions), Csat (rating footer), Icon (glyphs). Shadow is the DS Elevate/Overlays effect style. No dedicated Figma component — built from the presenter Import notification (AHA2-171 / AHA2-400).

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI. The [data-probe] is a running card at 42%: the card must be a white 320px radius-12 surface with a 13px ink heading, and the bar must carry the real percent.
